patthana1.2:550.1: Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ nissāya kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ nissāya tayo khandhā; tayo khandhe nissāya eko khandho; dve khandhe nissāya dve khandhā. (iii) Kusalaṃ . . . avyākato . . . uppajjati hetupaccayā. Kusale khandhe nissāya cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (iv) Kusalaṃ dhammaṃ nissāya kusalo ca avyākato ca dhamma uppajjanti hetupaccayā. Kusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ nissāya tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ; tayo . . .; dve . . . cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ. (viii, a)
patthana1.2:551.1: Akusalaṃ . . . akusalo . . . uppajjati hetupaccayā. Akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ nissāya tayo khandhā . . . pe . . . dve khandhe nissāya dve khandhā. (viii, c) Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ nissāya avyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Akusale khandhe nissāya cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ. (viii, d) Akusalaṃ dhammaṃ nissāya akusalo ca avyākato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā. Akusalaṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ nissāya tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ . . . pe . . . dve khandhā cittasamutthānañ ca rūpaṃ.
patthana1.2:552.1: (ix, a) Avyākataṃ dhammaṃ nissāya avyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Vipākāvyākataṃ kiriyāvyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ nissāya tayo khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ . . . pe . . . dve khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpaṃ. Paṭisandhikkhane vipākāvyākataṃ ekaṃ khandhaṃ nissāya tayo khandhā kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ, tayo . . . dve khandhi kaṭattā ca rūpaṃ. Khandhe nissāya vatthu; vatthuṃ nissāya khandhā. Ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ nissāya tayo mahābhūtā; tayo mahābhūte nissāya ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ; dve . . . dve mahābhūtā. Mahābhūte nissāya cittasamuṭṭhānaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattā rūpaṃ upādā rūpaṃ. Vatthuṃ nissāya vipākāvyākatā kiriyāvyākatā khandhā.
patthana1.2:553.1: (ix, b) Avyakataṃ . . . kusalo . . . uppajjati hetupaccayā. Vatthuṃ nissāya kusalā khandhā.
patthana1.2:554.1: (ix, c) Avyākataṃ . . . akusalo . . . uppajjati hetupaccayā. Vatthuṃ nissāya akusalā khandhā.

patthana1.2:713.1: Saṃsaṭṭhattaṃ nāma sampayuttattaṃ; sampayuttattaṃ nāma saṃsaṭṭhattaṃ. [Pañhavāro.] 1.
patthana1.2:714.1: Kusalo dhammo kusalassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. Kusalo hetu taṃ-sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. Kusalo dhammo avyākatassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. Kusalo hetu cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. Kusalo dhammo kusalassa ca avyākatassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. Kusalo hetu-sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:715.1: Akusalo dhammo akusalassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. Akusalo hetu taṃ-sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. Akusalo dhammo avyākatassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. Akusalo hetu cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. Akusalo dhammo akusalassa ca avyākatassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. Akusalo hetu sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:716.1: Avyākato dhammo avyākatassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. Vipākāvyākatā kiriyāvyākatā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākāvyākatā hetū sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ hetupaccayena paccayo. 2.
patthana1.2:717.1: Kusalo . . . kusalassa . . . ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Dānaṃ datvā, sīlaṃ samādiyitvā, uposathakammaṃ katvā, taṃ paccavekkhati; pubbe suciṇṇāni paccavekkhati; jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ paccavekkhati; sekhā gotrabhuṃ paccavekkhanti, vodānaṃ paccavekkhanti; sekhā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhanti; sekhā vā puthujjanā vā kusalaṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti, cetopariyañāṇena kusalacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānanti. Ākāsānañcāyatanakusalaṃ viññaṇañcāyatanakusalassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Ākiñcaññāyatanakusalaṃ nevasaññā-nāsaññāyatanakusalassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Kusalā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa cetopariyañāṇassa pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa yathākammūpagañāṇassa anāgataṃsañāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:718.1: Kusalo . . . akusalassa . . . ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Dānaṃ datvā, sīlaṃ samādiyitvā, uposathakammaṃ katvā, taṃ assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati, domanassaṃ uppajjati; pubbe suciṇṇāni assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati, domanassaṃ uppajjati; jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati, jhāne vippaṭisārassa domanassaṃ uppajjati.
patthana1.2:719.1: Kusalo . . . avyākatassa . . .ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Arahā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni paccavekkhati, kusalaṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, cetopariyañāṇena kusalacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jhānāti; sekhā vā puthujjanā vā kusalaṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti, kusale niruddhe vipāko tad-ārammaṇatā uppajjati; kusalaṃ assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati, domanassaṃ uppajjati; akusale niruddhe vipāko tad-ārammaṇatā uppajjati. Ākāsānañcāyatanakusalaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanavipākassa ca kiriyassa ca ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Ākiñcaññāyatanakusalaṃ nevasaññā-nāsaññāyatanavipākassa ca kiriyassa ca ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Kusalā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa yathākammūpagañāṇassa anāgataṃsañāṇassa āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:720.1: Akusalo . . . akusalassa . . . ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Rāgaṃ assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi . . . vicikicchā . . . uddhaccaṃ . . . domanassaṃ uppajjati; diṭṭhiṃ assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati . . . pe . . . vicikicchaṃ ārabbha vicikicchā uppajjati, diṭṭhi . . . uddhaccaṃ . . . diṭṭhi . . . domanassaṃ uppajjati; uddhaccaṃ ārabbha uddhaccaṃ uppajjati, vicikicchā . . . domanassaṃ ārabbha domanassaṃ uppajjati, vicikicchā uppajjati, uddhaccaṃ uppajjati.
patthana1.2:721.1: Akusalo . . . kusalassa . . . ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Sekhā pahīnakilese paccavekkhanti, vikkhambhitakilese paccavekkhanti, pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānanti. Sekhā vā puthujjanā vā akusalaṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti, cetopariyañāṇena akusalacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānanti. Akusalā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa pubbenivāsānussatiñaṇassa yathākammūpagañāṇassa anāgataṃsañāṇassa āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:722.1: Akusalo . . . avyākatassa . . . ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Arahā pahīnakilese paccavekkhati, pubbe samudāciṇṇe kilese jānāti, akusalaṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, cetopariyañāṇena akusalacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti. Sekhā vā puthujjanā vā akusalaṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti. Akusale niruddhe vipāko tad-ārammaṇatā uppajjati. Akusalaṃ assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi . . . vicikicchā . . . uddhaccaṃ . . . domanassaṃ uppajjati. Akusale niruddhe vipāko tad-ārammaṇatā uppajjati. Akusalā khandhā cetopariyañāṇassa pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa yathākammūpagañāṇassa anāgataṃsañāṇassa āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:723.1: Avyākato . . . avyākatassa . . . ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Arahā phalaṃ paccavekkhati, nibbānaṃ paccavekkhati. Nibbānaṃ phalassa āvajjanāya ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Arahā cakkhuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, sotaṃ, ghānaṃ, jivhaṃ, kāyaṃ, rūpe, sadde, gandhe, rase, phoṭṭhabbe, vatthuṃ . . . Vipākāvyākate kiriyāvyākate khandhe aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti, cetopariyañāṇena vipākāvyākatakiriyāvyākatacittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānāti. Ākāsānañcāyatanakiriyaṃ viññāṇañcāyatanakiriyassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Ākiñcaññāyatanakiriyaṃ nevasaññā-nāsaññāyatanakiriyassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Saddāyatanaṃ cetoviññāṇassa, gandhāyatanaṃ ghānaviññāṇassa; rasāyatanaṃ jivhāviññāṇassa, phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Avyākatā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa cetopariyañāṇassa pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa anāgataṃsañāṇassa āvajjanāya ārammaṇapacceyan paccayo.
patthana1.2:724.1: Avyākato . . . kusalassa . . . ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Sekhā phalaṃ paccavekkhanti nibbānaṃ paccavekkhanti. Nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa vodānassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. Sekhā vā puthujjanā vā cakkhuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti, sotaṃ ghānaṃ . . . rūpe . . . sadde . . . vatthuṃ . . . vipākāvyākate kiriyāvyākate khandhe aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passanti, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇanti, cetopariyañāṇana vipākāvyākata-kiriyāvyākata-cittasamaṅgissa cittaṃ jānanti. Avyākatā khandhā iddhividhañāṇassa cetopariyañāṇassa pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa anāgataṃsañāṇassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:725.1: Ayvākato . . . akusalassa . . . ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo Cakkhuṃ assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi . . . vicikicchā . . . uddhaccaṃ . . . domanassaṃ uppajjati. Sotaṃ . . . ghānaṃ . . . rūpe . . . phoṭṭhabbe vatthuṃ . . . Vipākāvyākate kiriyāvyākate khandhe assādeti abhinandati, taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi . . . vicikicchā . . . uddhaccaṃ . . . domanassaṃ uppajjati. 3.
patthana1.2:726.1: Kusalo dhammo kusalassa . . . adhipati p. paccayo. (a) Ārammaṇādhipati, (b) Sahajātādhipati. (a) Ārammaṇādhipati:-- dānaṃ datvā, sīlaṃ samādiyitvā uposathakammaṃ katvā taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, pubbe suciṇṇāni garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati; sekhā gotrabhuṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, vodānaṃ paccavekkhanti; sekhā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. (b) Sahajātādhipati :-- kusalādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:727.1: Kusalo dhammo akusalassa . . . adhipatip. paccayo. (a) Dānaṃ datvā, sīlaṃ samādiyitvā, uposathakammaṃ katvā, taṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati; taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Pubbe suciṇṇāni garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati; taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati; taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo . . . diṭṭhi uppajjati.
patthana1.2:728.1: Kusalo dhammo avyākatassa . . . adhipatip. paccayo. (a, b):-- (a) Arahā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati. (b) Kusalādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:729.1: Kusalo dhammo kusalassa ca avyākatassa ca dhammassa adhipatip. paccayo. (b) Kusalādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:730.1: Akusalo dhammo akusalassa . . . adhipatip. paccayo. (a, b):-- (a) Rāgaṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati; taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati diṭṭhi uppajjati; diṭṭhiṃ garuṃ katvā . . . (as above) . . . (b) Akusalādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:731.1: Akusalo dhammo avyākatassa adhipatip. paccayo. (b) Akusalādhipati cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:732.1: Akusalo dhammo akusalassa ca avyākatassa ca dhammassa adhipatip. paccayo. (b) Akusalādhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo. Avyākato dhammo avyākatassa . . . adhipatip. paccayo. . . . (a, b):-- (a) Arahā phalaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati, nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati. Nibbānaṃ phalassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo. (b) Vipākāvyākatā kiriyāvyākatā adhipati sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ adhipatipaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:734.1: dhammo kusalassa adhipatip. paccayo. (a) Sekhā phalaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. Nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa vodānassa maggassa adhipatipaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:735.1: Avyākato dhammo akusalassa . . . adhipatip. paccayo. (a) Cakkhuṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati; taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sotaṃ . . . rūpe . . . sadde . . . vatthuṃ . . . vipākāvyākate kiriyāvyākate khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati; taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati. 4.
patthana1.2:736.1: Kusalo dhammo kusalassa anantarap. paccayo. Purimā purimā kusalā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ kusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Anulomaṃ gotrabhussa, anulomaṃ vodānassa, gotrabhu maggassa, vodānaṃ maggassa anantarapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:737.1: Kusalo dhammo avyākatassa . . . anantarap. paccayo. Kusalaṃ vuṭṭhānassa, maggo phalassa, sekhānaṃ anulomaṃ phalasamāpattiyā, nirodhā vuṭṭhahantassa nevasaññā-nāsaññāyatanakusalaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:738.1: Akusalo dhammo akusalassa anantarap. paccayo. Purimā purimā akusalā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ akusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:739.1: Akusalo dhammo avyākatassa anantarap. paccayo. Akusalaṃ vuṭṭhānassa anantarapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:740.1: Avyākato dhammo avyākatassa . . . anantarap. paccayo. Purimā purimā vipākāvyākatā kiriyāvyākatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ vipākāvyākatānaṃ kiriyāvyākatānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. Bhavaṅgaṃ āvajjanāya, kiriyaṃ vuṭṭhānassa, arahato anulomaṃ phalasamāpattiyā, nirodhā vuṭṭhahantassa nevasaññā-nāsaññāyatanakiriyaṃ phalasamāpattiyā anantarapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:741.1: Avyākato dhammo kusalassa anantarap. paccayo. Āvajjanā kusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:742.1: Avyākato dhammo kusalassa anantarap. paccayo. Āvajjanā akusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ anantarapaccayena paccayo. 5.
patthana1.2:743.1: Kusalo dhammo kusalassa . . . samanantarap. paccayo. Purimā purimā kusalā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ kusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ samanantarapaccayena paccayo. Anulomaṃ gotrabhussa, anulomaṃ vodānassa, gotrabhu maggassa, vodānaṃ maggassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:744.1: Kusalo dhammo avyākatassa . . . samanantarap. paccayo. Kusalaṃ vuṭṭhānassa, maggo phalassa, sekhānaṃ anulomaṃ phalasamāpattiyā, nirodhā vuṭṭhahantassa nevasaññā-nāsaññāyatanakusalaṃ phalasamāpattiyā samanantarapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:745.1: Akusalo dhammo akusalassa . . . samanantarap. paccayo. Purimā purimā akusalā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ akusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ samanantarapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:746.1: Akusalo dhammo avyākatassa . . . samanantarap. paccayo. Akusalaṃ vuṭṭhānassa samanantarapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:747.1: Avyākato dhammo avyākatassa . . . samanantarap. paccayo. Purimā purimā vipākāvyākatā kiriyāvyākatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ vipākāvyākatānaṃ kiriyāvyākatānaṃ khandhānaṃ samanantarapaccayena paccayo. Bhavaṅgaṃ āvajjanāya, kiriyaṃ vuṭṭhānassa, arahato anulomaṃ phalasamāpattiyā, nirodhā vuṭṭhahantassa nevasaññā-nāsaññāyatanakiriyaṃ phalasamāpattiyā samanantarapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:748.1: Avyākato dhammo kusalassa . . . samanantarap. paccayo. Āvajjanā kusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ samanantarapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:749.1: Avyākato dhammo akusalassa samanantarap. paccayo. Āvajjanā akusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ samanantarapaccayena paccayo. 6.
patthana1.2:750.1: Kusalo dhammo kusalassa . . . sahajātap. paccayo. Kusalo eko khandho tiṇṇaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo; tayo khandhā ekassa khandhassa sahajātapaccayena paccayo; dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:751.1: Kusalo dhammo avyākatassa . . . sahajātap. paccayo. Kusalā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:752.1: Kusalo dhammo kusalassa ca avyākatassa ca dhammassa sahajātap. paccayo. Kusalo eko khandho tiṇṇaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā . . . (as above) dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:753.1: Akusalo dhammo akusalassa . . . sahajātap. paccayo. Akusalo eko khandho tiṇṇaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Tayo . . . pe . . . dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:754.1: Akusalo dhammo avyākatassa . . . sahajātap. paccayo. Akusalā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:755.1: Akusalo dhammo akusalassa ca avyākatassa ca dhammassa sahajātap. paccayo. Akusalo eko khandho tiṇṇaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ . . . tayo khandhā ekassa khandhassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca . . . dve . . . cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:756.1: Avyākato dhammo avyākatassa . . . sahajātap. paccayo. Vipākāvyākato kiriyāvyākato eko khandho tiṇṇaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ . . . tayo . . . (as above) cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpānaṃ . . . dve . . . sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākāvyākato eko khandho tiṇṇaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ . . . tayo . . . dve . . . kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Khandhā vatthussa . . . vatthu khandhānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ tiṇṇaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Tayo . . . pe . . . dvinnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Mahābhūtā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ, kaṭattā-rupānaṃ upādārūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Bāhiraṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ tiṇṇaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo . . . tayo dve . . . sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Mahābhūtā upādarūpānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ tiṇṇaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Tayo mahābhūtā ekassa . . . dve . . . dvinnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo. Mahābhūtā upādarūpānaṃ sahajāta . . . Utusamuṭṭhānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtāṃ tiṇṇaṃ . . . tayo . . . ekassa . . . dve . . . dvinnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ sahajāta . . . Mahābhūtā upādarūpānaṃ sahajāta . . . Asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ . . . tiṇṇaṃ . . . tayo . . . ekassa . . . dve . . . dvinnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ sahajāta . . . Mahābhūtā kaṭattā rūpānaṃ upādarūpanaṃ sahajātapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:757.1: Kusalo ca avyākato ca dhammā avyākatassa dhammassa sahajātap. paccayo. Kusalā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ sahajāta . . .
patthana1.2:758.1: Akusalo ca avyākato ca dhammā avyākatassa dhammassa sahajātap. paccayo. Akusalā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ sahajāta . . . 7.
patthana1.2:759.1: Kusalo dhammo kusalassa aññamaññap. paccayo. Kusalo eko khandho tiṇṇaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā . . . ekassa . . . dve . . . dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:760.1: Akusalo dhammo akusalassa . . . aññamaññap. paccayo. Akusalo eko khandho tiṇṇaṃ . . . pe . . . dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:761.1: Avyākato dhammo avyākatassa . . . aññamaññap. paccayo. Vipākāvyākato kiriyāvyākato eko khandho tiṇṇaṃ . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākāvyākato eko khandho tiṇṇaṃ khandhānaṃ vatthussa ca aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Tayo . . .; dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ vatthussa ca aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Khandhā vatthussa . . . vatthu khandhānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo. Ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ tiṇṇaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ aññamaññapaccayena paccayo; tayo mahābhūtā . . .; dve mahābhūtā. . . . Bāhiraṃ . . . Āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ . . . Utusamuṭṭhānaṃ . . . Asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ tiṇṇaṃ . . . pe . . . 8.
patthana1.2:762.1: Kusalo dhammo kusalassa . . . nissayap. paccayo. Kusalo eko khandho tiṇṇaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo; tayo khandhā ekassa khandhassa . . .; dve khandhā.
patthana1.2:763.1: Kusalo dhammo avyākatassa . . . nissayap. paccayo. Kusalā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:764.1: Kusalo dhammo kusalassa ca avyākatassa ca dhammassa nissayap. paccayo. Kusalo eko khandho tiṇṇaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. Tayo khandhā . . . ; dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:765.1: Akusalo dhammo akusalassa . . . nissayap. paccayo. Akusalo eko khandho tiṇṇaṃ . . .
patthana1.2:766.1: Akusalo dhammo avyākatassa . . . nissayap. paccayo. Akusalo eko khandho tiṇṇaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:767.1: Akusalo dhammo akusalassa ca avyākatassa ca dhammassa nissayap. paccayo. Akusalo eko khandho tiṇṇaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ. . . . Tayo khandhā . . .; dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ nissaya . . . Avyākato
patthana1.2:768.1: dhammo avyākatassa . . . nissayap. paccayo. Vipākāvyākato kiriyāvyākato eko khandho tiṇṇaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ . . . tayo khandhā . . .; dve . . . cittasamuṭṭhānanañ ca rūpānaṃ . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākāvyākato eko khandho tiṇṇaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ . . . tayo . . . ekassa . . . dve . . . dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ nissaya. . . . [Khandhā vatthussa nissaya . . . vatthu khandhānaṃ nissaya. . . Ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ tiṇṇaṃ . . . tayo . . ekassa . . . dve . . dvinnaṃ mahābhūtanaṃ nissaya.] . . . Mahābhūtā cittasamuṭṭhānañ ca rūpānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ upādarūpānañ ca nissaya . . . Bāhiraṃ . . . Āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ . . . Utusamuṭṭhānaṃ . . . Asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ . . . tiṇṇaṃ . . . dve . . . dvinnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ nissaya . . . mahābhūtā kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ upādā rūpānañ ca nissaya . . . Cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññānassa . . . Sotāyatanaṃ . . . Ghānāyatanaṃ . . . Jivhāyatanaṃ . . . Kāyāyatanaṃ kāya viññāṇassa nissayapaccayena paccayo. Vatthu vipakāvyākatānaṃ kiriyāvyākatānaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:769.1: Avyākato dhammo kusalassa . . .nissayap. paccayo. Vatthu kusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ nissaya . . . Avyākato
patthana1.2:770.1: dhammo akusalassa . . . nissayap. paccayo. Vatthu akusalānaṃ . . .
patthana1.2:771.1: Kusalo ca avyākato ca dhammā kusalassa dhammassa nissayap-paccayo. Kusalo eko khandho ca vatthuñ ca tinnaṃ khandhānaṃ nissaya. . . . Tayo khandhā . . .; dve khandhā ca vatthu ca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ nissaya . . .
patthana1.2:772.1: Kusalo ca avyākato ca dhammā avyākatassa dhammassa nissayap. paccayo. Kusalā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ nissaya. . . .
patthana1.2:773.1: Akusalo ca avyākato ca dhammā akusalassa . . . nissayap. paccayo. Akusalo eko khandho ca vatthu ca tiṇṇaṃ; . . . tayo . . . ekassa . . .; dve khandhā ca vatthu ca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:774.1: Akusalo ca avyākato ca dhammā avyākatassa dhammassa nissayap. paccayo. Akusalā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ nissayapaccayena paccayo. 9.
patthana1.2:775.1: Kusalo dhammo kusalassa dhammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. (a) Ārammaṇūpanissayo, (b) anantarūpanissayo, (c) pakatūpanissayo.
patthana1.2:776.1: (a) Dānaṃ datvā, sīlaṃ samādiyitvā, uposathakammaṃ katvā, taṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati; pubbe suciññāni garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati; jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā, jhānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati; sekhā gotrabhuṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti; vodānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti; sekhā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā, maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti.
patthana1.2:777.1: (b) Purimā purimā kusalā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ kusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Anulomaṃ gotrabhussa, anulomaṃ vodānassa, gotrabhu maggassa, vodānaṃ maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:778.1: (c) Saddhaṃ upanissāya, dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ karoti: jhānaṃ uppādeti, vipassanaṃ . . . maggaṃ . . . abhiññaṃ . . . samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Sīlaṃ, sutaṃ, cāgaṃ, paññaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati . . . (as above). Saddhā, sīlaṃ, sutaṃ, cāgo, paññā saddhāya, sīlassa, sutassa, cāgassa, paññāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:779.1: Paṭhamassa jhānassa parikammaṃ paṭhamassa jhānassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo; dutiyassa jhānassa parikammaṃ dutiyassa jhānassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo; . . . (so for tatiyaṃ and catutthaṃ jhānaṃ). Ākāsānañcāyatanassa parikammaṃ ākāsānañcāyatanassa upanissap. paccayo; . . . (so for viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ, ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ, nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ). Paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ dutiyassa jhānassa . . . catutthassa jhānassa upanissayap. paccayo. Catutthaṃ jhānaṃ ākāsānañcāyatanassa, ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ . . . pe . . . nevasaññānāsaññāyatanassa upanissap. paccayo. Dibbassa cakkhussa parikammaṃ dibbassa cakkhussa. Upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Dibbāya sotadhātuyā parikammaṃ dibbāya sotadhātuyā, iddhividhañāṇassa parikammaṃ iddhividhañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇassa parikammaṃ cetopariyañāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa parikammaṃ pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, yathākammupagañāṇassa parikammaṃ yathākammūpagañāṇassa, anāgataṃsañāṇassa parikammaṃ anāgataṃsañāṇassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo Dibbaṃ cakkhuṃ dibbāya sotadhātuyā, dibbā sotadhātu iddhividhañāṇassa, iddhividhañāṇaṃ cetopariyañāṇassa, cetopariyañāṇaṃ pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇassa, pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇaṃ yathākammūpagañāṇassa yathākammūpagañāṇaṃ anāgataṃsañāṇassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Paṭhamassa maggassa parikammaṃ paṭhamassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo . . . (so for the 2nd to 4th Paths.). Paṭhamo maggo dutiyassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Dutiyo maggo tatiyassa, tatiyo maggo catutthassa maggassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Sekhā maggaṃ upanissāya anuppannaṃ samāpattiṃ uppādenti uppannaṃ samāpajjanti saṅkhāre aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti. Maggo sekhānaṃ atthapaṭisambhidāya dhammapaṭisambhidāya niruttipaṭisambhidāya paṭibhāṇapaṭisambhidāya ṭhānāṭhānakosallassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:780.1: Kusalo dhammo akusalassa . . . upanissayap. paccayo. (a) Ārammaṇūpanissayo, (c) pakatūpanissayo.
patthana1.2:781.1: (a) Dānaṃ datvā, sīlaṃ samādiyitvā, uposathakammaṃ datvā, taṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati; taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Pubbe suciṇṇāni taṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati; jhānā vuṭṭhahitvā jhānaṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati, taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo . . . diṭṭhi uppajjati.
patthana1.2:782.1: (c) Saddhaṃ upanissāya mānaṃ jappeti; diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Sīlaṃ, sutaṃ, cāgaṃ, paññaṃ upanissāya mānaṃ jappeti, diṭṭhiṃ gaṇhāti. Saddhā, sīlaṃ, sutaṃ, cāgo, paññā rāgassa, dosassa, mohassa, mānassa, diṭṭhiyā, patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:783.1: Kusalo dhammo avyākatassa . . . upanissayap. paccayo. (a) Ārammaṇūpanissayo, (b) anantarūpanissayo, (c) pakatūpanissayo.
patthana1.2:784.1: (a) Arahā maggā vuṭṭhahitvā maggaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati.
patthana1.2:785.1: (b) Kusalaṃ vuṭṭhānassa, maggo phalassa, sekhānaṃ anulomaṃ phalasamāpattiyā, nirodhā vuṭṭhāhantassa nevasaññā -nāsaññāyatanakusalaṃ phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:786.1: (c) Saddhaṃ upanissāya attānaṃ ātāpeti paritāpeti, pariyiṭṭhimūlakaṃ dukkhaṃ paccanubhoti. Sīlaṃ, sutaṃ, cāgaṃ, paññaṃ upanissāya attānaṃ . . . pe . . . Saddhā, sīlaṃ, sutaṃ, cāgo, paññā, kāyikassa sukhassa kāyikassa dukkhassa phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Kusalaṃ kammaṃ vipākassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Arahā maggaṃ upanissāya anuppannaṃ kiriyasamāpattiṃ uppādeti, uppannaṃ samāpajjati, saṅkhāre aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati. Maggo arahato atthapaṭisambhidāya dhammapaṭisambhidāya niruttipaṭisambhidāya paṭibhāṇapaṭisambhidāya ṭhānāṭhānakosallassa . . . Maggo phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:787.1: Akusalo dhammo akusalassa upanissayap. paccayo. (a) Ārammanūpanissayo, (b) anantarūpanissayo, (c) pakatūpanissayo:--
patthana1.2:788.1: (a) Rāgaṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo . . . diṭṭhi uppajjati. Diṭṭhiṃ garuṃ katvā . . . rāgo uppajjati. (b) Purimā
patthana1.2:789.1: purimā akusalā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ akusalānaṃ khandhanaṃ upanissayapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:790.1: (c) Rāgaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati, adinnaṃ ādiyati, musā bhaṇati, pisuṇaṃ bhaṇati, pharusaṃ bhaṇati, samphaṃ palapati, sandhiṃ chindati, nillopaṃ harati, ekāgārikaṃ karoti paripanthe tiṭṭhati, paradāraṃ gacchati, gāmaghātaṃ karoti, nigamaghātaṃ karoti, mātaraṃ jīvitā voropeti, pitaraṃ jīvitā voropeti, arahantaṃ jīvitā voropeti, duṭṭhena cittena tathāgatassa lohitaṃ uppādeti, saṅghaṃ bhindati. Dosaṃ upanissāya . . . mohaṃ, mānaṃ, diṭṭhiṃ, patthanaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati . . . pe . . . saṅghaṃ bhindati. Rāgo, doso, moho, māno, diṭṭhi, patthanā rāgassa dosassa mohassa mānassa diṭṭhiyā patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Pāṇātipāto pāṇātipātassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Pāṇātipāto adinnādānassa, kāmesu micchācārassa, musāvādassa, pisuṇāvācāya, pharusāvācāya, samphappalāpassa, abhijjhāya vyāpādassa, micchādiṭṭhiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Adinnādānaṃ adinnādānassa, kāmesu micchācārassa musāvādassa . . . saṅkhittaṃ . . . micchādiṭṭhi pāṇātipātassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo . . . cakkaṃ bandhitabbaṃ. Kāmesu micchācāro, musāvādo, pisuṇavācā, pharusavācā, samphappalāpo, abhijjhā, vyāpādo, micchādiṭṭhi micchādiṭṭhiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo, micchādiṭṭhi pāṇātipātassa adinnādānassa . . . vyāpādassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Mātughātakammaṃ mātughātakammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Matūghātakammaṃ pitughātakammassa arahantaghātakammassa ruhiruppādakammassa saṅghabhedakammassa niyatamicchādiṭṭhiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Pitughātakammaṃ pitughātakammassa . . . pe . . . arahantaghātakammassa ruhiruppādakammassa saṅghabhedakammassa niyatamicchādiṭṭhiyā mātughātakammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Arahantaghātakammaṃ . . . ruhiruppādakammaṃ . . . saṅghabhedakammaṃ . . . niyatamicchādiṭṭhi niyatamicchādiṭṭhiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Niyatamicchādiṭṭhi mātughātakammassa . . . arahantaghātakammassa ruhiruppādakammassa saṅghabhedakammassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo . . . (cakkaṃ kātabbaṃ).
patthana1.2:791.1: Akusalo dhammo kusalassa . . . upanissayap. paccayo. (c) Pakatūpanissayo:-- rāgaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ karoti; jhānaṃ uppādeti, vipassanaṃ uppādeti, maggaṃ . . . abhiññaṃ . . . samāpattiṃ uppādeti. So for dosaṃ, mohaṃ, mānaṃ, diṭṭhiṃ, patthanaṃ. Rāgo, doso, moho, māno, diṭṭhi, patthanā saddhāya, sīlassa, sutassa, cāgassa, paññāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Pāṇaṃ hantvā tassa paṭighātatthāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ karoti; jhānaṃ uppādeti, vipassanaṃ, maggaṃ, abhiññaṃ, samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Adinnaṃ ādayitvā, musā bhaṇitvā, pisuṇaṃ bhaṇitvā, pharusaṃ bhanitvā, samphaṃ palapitvā, sandhiṃ chinditvā, nillopaṃ karitvā, ekāgārikaṃ karitvā, paripanthe ṭhatvā, paradāraṃ gantvā, gāmaghātaṃ karitvā, nigamaghātaṃ karitvā tassa paṭighātatthāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ karoti; jhanaṃ uppādeti, vipassanaṃ, maggaṃ, abhiññaṃ, samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Mātaraṃ jīvitā voropetvā tassa paṭighātatthāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ karoti; . . . pe . . . pitaraṃ jīvitā voropetvā, arahantaṃ jīvitā voropetvā, duṭṭhena cittena tathāgatassa lohitaṃ uppādetvā, saṅghaṃ bhinditvā tassa paṭighātatthāya dānaṃ deti, silaṃ samādiyati uposathakammaṃ karoti . . . pe . . .
patthana1.2:792.1: Akusalo dhammo avyākatassa upanissayap. paccayo. (b) Anantarūpanissayo, (c) pakatūpanissayo.
patthana1.2:794.1: (c) Rāgaṃ upanissāya attānaṃ ātāpeti, paritāpeti, pariyiṭṭhimūlakaṃ dukkhaṃ paccanubhoti. So for dosaṃ, mohaṃ, mānaṃ, diṭṭhiṃ, patthanaṃ. Rāgo, doso, moso, māno, diṭṭhi, patthanā kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Akusalaṃ kammaṃ vipākassa upanissaya . . . Avyākato
patthana1.2:795.1: dhammo avyākatassa . . . upanissayap. paccayo. (a, b, c):-- (a)
patthana1.2:796.1: Arahā phalaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhati. Nibbānaṃ phalassa upanissayapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:797.1: (b) Purimā purimā vipākāvyākatā kiriyāvyākatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ vipākāvyākatānaṃ kiriyāvyākatānaṃ upanissayap. . . . Bhavaṅgaṃ āvajjanāya, kiriyaṃ vuṭṭhānassa, arahato anulomaṃ phalasamāpattiyā, nirodhā vuṭṭhāhantassa nevasaññā-nāsaññāyatanakiriyaṃ phalasamāpattiyā upanissaya . . . (c)
patthana1.2:798.1: Kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa phalasamāpattiyā upanissayapaccayena paccayo. Kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ kāyikassa dukkhassa, kāyikassa sukhassa phalasamāpattiyā . . . pe . . . Utu kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa phalasamāpattiyā upanissaya . . . Bhojanaṃ kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa phalasamāpattiyā upanissaya . . . Senāsanaṃ kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa phalasamāpattiyā upanissaya . . . Kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ. Kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ, utu, bhojanaṃ, senāsanaṃ kāyikassa sukhassa, kāyikassa dukkhassa phalasamāpattiyā, phalasamāpatti kāyikassa sukhassa upanissayap. . . .
patthana1.2:799.1: Arahā kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ upanissāya anuppannaṃ kiriyasamāpattiṃ uppādeti, uppannaṃ samāpajjati, saṅkhāre aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati; kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ, utuṃ, bhojanaṃ, sanāsanaṃ upanissāya anuppannaṃ kiriyasamāpattiṃ uppādeti, uppannaṃ samāpajjati, saṅkhāre aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati.
patthana1.2:800.1: Avyākato dhammo kusalassa . . . upanissayap. paccayo. (a, b, c):-- (a)
patthana1.2:801.1: Sekhā phalaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti, nibbānaṃ garuṃ katvā paccavekkhanti. Nibbānaṃ gotrabhussa, vodānaṃ maggassa upanissayap. . . . (b)
patthana1.2:803.1: (c) Kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ samādiyati, uposathakammaṃ karoti; jhānaṃ uppādeti, vipassanaṃ, maggaṃ, abhiññaṃ, samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ, utuṃ, bhojanaṃ senāsanaṃ upanissāya dānaṃ deti, sīlaṃ . . . pe . . . samāpattiṃ uppādeti. Kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ, kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ, utu, bhojanaṃ, senāsanaṃ saddhāya, sīlassa, sutassa, cāgassa, paññāya upanissayap. . . . Avyākato
patthana1.2:804.1: dhammo akusalassa upanissayap. paccayo. (a, b, c):-- (a)
patthana1.2:805.1: Cakkhuṃ garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati; taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati. Sotaṃ . . . pe . . . Rūpe . . . vatthuṃ . . . Vipākāvyākate kiriyāvyākate khandhe garuṃ katvā assādeti abhinandati: taṃ garuṃ katvā rāgo uppajjati, diṭṭhi uppajjati.
patthana1.2:807.1: (c) Kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati, adinnaṃ ādiyati, musā bhaṇati, pisuṇaṃ bhaṇati, pharusaṃ bhaṇati, samphaṃ palapati; sandhiṃ chindati, nillopaṃ harati, ekāgārikaṃ karoti, paripanthe tiṭṭhati, paradāraṃ gacchati, gāmaghātaṃ karoti, nigamaghātaṃ karoti; mātaraṃ, pitaraṃ, arahantaṃ jīvitā voropeti, duṭṭhena cittena Tathāgatassa lohitaṃ uppādeti, saṅghaṃ bhindati.
patthana1.2:808.1: Kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ, utuṃ, bhojanaṃ, senāsanaṃ upanissāya pāṇaṃ hanati . . . saṅkhittaṃ . . . saṅghaṃ bhindati.
patthana1.2:809.1: Kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ, kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ, utuṃ, bhojanaṃ, senāsanaṃ rāgassa dosassa mohassa mānassa diṭṭhiyā patthanāya upanissayapaccayena paccayo. 10. Avyākato
patthana1.2:810.1: dhammo avyākatassa purejātap. paccayo. (a) Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, (b) vatthupurejātaṃ.
patthana1.2:811.1: (a) Arahā cakkhuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati. Sotaṃ . . . rūpe . . . vatthuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati, dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Saddāyatanaṃ sotaviññāṇassa . . . phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:812.1: (b) Cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa . . . sotāyatanaṃ sotaviññāṇassa . . . kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa purejātapaccayena paccayo. Vatthu vipakāvyākatānaṃ kiriyāvyākatānaṃ khandhānaṃ purejātapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:813.1: Avyākato dhammo kusalassa . . . purejātap. paccayo. (a) Ārammaṇapurejātaṃ, (b) vatthupurejātaṃ.
patthana1.2:814.1: (a) Sekhā vā puthujjanā vā cakkhuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti. Sotaṃ . . . rūpe . . . vatthu aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti, dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passanti, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇanti.
patthana1.2:816.1: Avyākato dhammo akusalassa . . . purejātap. paccayo. (a, b):-- (a) Cakkhuṃ assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo, diṭṭhi, vicikicchā, uddhaccaṃ, domanassaṃ uppajjati. Sotaṃ . . . rūpe . . . vatthuṃ assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo . . . domanassaṃ uppajjati.
patthana1.2:818.1: Kusalo dhammo avyākatassa pacchājātap. paccayo. Pacchājātā kusalā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:819.1: Akusalo dhammo avyākatassa pacchājātap. paccayo. Pacchājātā akusalā khandhā . . . (as above). Avyākato dhammo avyākatassa . . . pacchājātap. paccayo.
patthana1.2:820.1: Vipākāvyākatā kiriyāvyākatā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa pacchājātapaccayena paccayo. 12.
patthana1.2:821.1: Kusalo dhammo kusalassa . . . āsevanap. paccayo. Purimā purimā kusalā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ kusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ āsevanapaccayena paccayo. Anulomaṃ gotrabhussa, anulomaṃ vodānassa, gotrabhu maggassa, vodānaṃ maggassa āsevanapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:822.1: Akusalo dhammo akusalassa . . . āsevanap. paccayo. Purimā purimā akusalā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ akusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ āsevana . . . Avyākato dhammo avyākatassa āsevanap. paccayo.
patthana1.2:823.1: Purimā purimā kiriyāvyākatā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ kiriyāvyākatānaṃ khandhānaṃ āsevanapaccayena paccayo. 13.
patthana1.2:824.1: Kusalo dhammo kusalassa kammap. paccayo. Kusalā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:825.1: Kusalo dhammo avyākatassa . . . kammap. paccayo. (a) Sahajātā, (b) nānākhaṇikā. (a) Kusalā cetanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (b) Nānākhaṇikā kusalā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:826.1: Kusalo dhammo kusalassa ca avyākatassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo. Kusalā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ kamma . . .
patthana1.2:827.1: Akusalo dhammo akusalassa . . . kammap. paccayo. Akusalā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kamma . . .
patthana1.2:828.1: Akusalo dhammo avyākatassa . . . kammap. paccayo. (a) Sahajātā, (b) nānākhaṇikā. (a) Akusalā cetanā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo. (b) Akusalā cetanā vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kamma . . .
patthana1.2:829.1: Akusalo dhammo akusalassa ca avyākatassa ca dhammassa kammapaccayena paccayo. Akusalā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ kamma . . . Avyākato
patthana1.2:830.1: dhammo avyākatassa . . . kammap. paccayo. Vipākāvyākatā kiriyāvyākatā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ kamma . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākāvyākatā cetanā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ kamma . . . Cetanā vatthussa kammapaccayena paccayo. 14. Avyākato
patthana1.2:831.1: dhammo avyākatassa . . . vipākap. paccayo. Vipākāvyākato eko khandho tiṇṇaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ, tayo khandhā ekassa khandhassa cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ, dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākāvyākato eko khandho tiṇṇaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ, tayo khandhā . . . dve khandhā dvinaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ vipāka . . . Khandhā vatthussa vipākapaccayena paccayo. 15.
patthana1.2:832.1: Kusalo dhammo kusalassa . . . āhārap. paccayo. Kusalā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ āhārapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:833.1: Kusalo dhammo avyākatassa . . . āhārap. paccayo. Kusalā āhārā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ āhāra . . .
patthana1.2:834.1: Kusalo dhammo kusalassa ca avyākatassa ca dhammassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. Kusalā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhanānañ ca rūpānaṃ āhārap. . . .

patthana1.2:838.1: dhammo avyākatassa . . . āhārap. paccayo. Vipākāvyākatā kiriyāvyākatā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ āhāra . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākāvyākatā āhārā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ āhāra. . . . Kabaḷiṅkāro āhāro imassa kāyassa āhārapaccayena paccayo. 16.

patthana1.2:844.1: Akusalo dhammo akusalassa ca avyākatassa ca dhammassa indriyap. paccayo. Akusalā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ indriya . . . Avyākato
patthana1.2:845.1: dhammo avyākatassa . . . indriyap. paccayo. Vipākāvyākatā kiriyāvyākatā indriyā sampayuttakānaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ indriya . . . patthana1.2:861.1: Akusalo dhammo akusalassa . . . sampayuttap. paccayo. Akusalo eko khandho . . . (as above). Avyākato
patthana1.2:862.1: dhammo avyākatassa . . . sampayuttap. paccayo. Vipākāvyākato kiriyāvyākato eko khandho . . . (as above). 20.
patthana1.2:863.1: Kusalo dhammo avyākatassa . . . vippayuttap. paccayo. (a) Sahajātaṃ, (b) pacchājātaṃ. (a) Sahajātā kusalā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (b) Pacchājātā kusalā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttapaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:864.1: Akusalo dhammo avyākatassa . . . vippayuttap. paccayo. (a, b):-- (a) Sahajātā akusalā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. (b) Pacchājātā akusalā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttap. paccayo.
patthana1.2:865.1: Avyākato dhammo avyākatassa . . . vippayuttap. paccayo. (a) Sahajātaṃ, (b) purejātaṃ, (c) pacchājātaṃ. (a) Vipākāvyākatā kiriyāvyākatā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākāvyākatā khandhā kaṭattārūpānaṃ vippayutta. . . . Khandhā vatthussa . . . vatthu khandhānaṃ vippayutta . . . (b) Cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa vippayutta . . . sotāyatanaṃ sotaviññāṇassa . . . kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa vippayutta . . . vatthu vipākāvyākatānaṃ kiriyāvyākatānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayutta . . . (c) Vipākāvyākatā kiriyāvyākatā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa vippayuttap. paccayo.
patthana1.2:866.1: Avyākato dhammo kusalassa . . . vippayuttap. paccayo. (b) Vatthu kusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayutta . . . Avyākato
patthana1.2:867.1: dhammo akusalassa . . . vippayuttap. paccayo. (b) Vatthu akusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ vippayuttapaccayena paccayo. 21.
patthana1.2:868.1: Kusalo dhammo kusalassa . . . atthipaccayena paccayo. Kusalo eko khandho tiṇṇaṃ khandhānaṃ, tayo khandhā ekassa khandhassa, dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:869.1: Kusalo dhammo avyākatassa . . . atthip. paccayo. (a) Sahajātaṃ, (b) pacchājātaṃ. (a) Kusalā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. (b) Kusalā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:870.1: Kusalo dhammo kusalassa ca avyākatassa ca dhammassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Kusalo eko khandho tiṇṇaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ, tayo khandhā ekassa . . . dve khandhā dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ atthip. . . .
patthana1.2:871.1: Akusalo dhammo akusalassa . . . atthip. paccayo. Akusalo eko khandho tiṇṇaṃ, dve dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ atthip. paccayo.
patthana1.2:872.1: Akusalo dhammo avyākatassa . . . atthip. paccayo. (a, b):-- (a) Akusalā khandhā cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthi . . . (b) Akusalā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthipaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:873.1: Akusalo dhammo akusalassa ca avyākatassa ca dhammassa atthip. paccayo. Akusalo eko khandho tiṇṇaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ . . . dve . . . dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ atthi . . . Avyākato
patthana1.2:874.1: dhammo avyākatassa . . . atthip. paccayo. (a) Sahajātaṃ, (b) purejātaṃ, (c) pacchājātaṃ (1) āhāraṃ, (2) indriyaṃ. (a) Sahajāto vipākāvyākato kiriyāvyākato eko khandho tiṇṇaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ . . . dve . . . dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ atthi . . . Paṭisandhikkhaṇe vipākāvyākato eko khandho tiṇṇaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ . . . dve . . . dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ atthi. . . . Khandhā vatthussa, vatthu khandhānaṃ atthi. Ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ tiṇṇaṃ mahabhūtānaṃ . . . dve . . . dvinnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ atthi. . . . Mahābhūtā cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ upādārūpānañ ca atthipaccayena paccayo. Bāhiraṃ . . . Āhārasamuṭṭhānaṃ . . . Utusamuṭṭhānaṃ . . . Asaññasattānaṃ ekaṃ mahābhūtaṃ tiṇṇaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ atthi. . . . Mahābhūtā [cittasamuṭṭhānānañ ca rūpānaṃ] kaṭattā ca rūpānaṃ upādārūpānañ ca atthipaccayena paccayo. (b) Arahā
patthana1.2:875.1: cakkhuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati; sotaṃ . . . rūpe . . . vatthuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassati; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati, dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇāti. Rūpāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa atthipaccayena paccayo. Saddāyatanaṃ . . . pe . . . phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa atthi. . . . Cakkhāyatanaṃ cakkhuviññāṇassa atthi. . . . Sotāyatanaṃ sotaviññāṇassa. . . . Kāyāyatanaṃ kāyaviññāṇassa atthi. . . . Vatthu vipākāvyākatānaṃ kiriyāvyākatānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthi. . . . (c) Pacchājātā vipākāvyākatā kiriyavyākatā khandhā purejātassa imassa kāyassa atthi. . . . Kabaḷiṅkāro āhāro imassa kāyassa atthi. . . . Rūpajīvitindriyaṃ kaṭattā-rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. Avyākato
patthana1.2:876.1: dhammo kusalassa . . . atthip. paccayo. (b) Sekhā vā puthujjanā va cakkhuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti; sotaṃ . . . rūpe . . . vatthuṃ aniccato dukkhato anattato vipassanti; dibbena cakkhunā rūpaṃ passanti; dibbāya sotadhātuyā saddaṃ suṇanti. Vatthuṃ kusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo.
patthana1.2:877.1: Avyākato dhammo akusalassa . . . atthip. paccayo. (b) Purejātaṃ cakkhuṃ assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo, diṭṭhi, vicikicchā, uddhaccaṃ, domanassaṃ uppajjati; sotaṃ . . . pe . . . ghānaṃ . . . rūpe . . . vatthuṃ assādeti abhinandati; taṃ ārabbha rāgo uppajjati . . . pe . . . domanassaṃ uppajjati. Vatthuṃ akusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ atthi. . . .
patthana1.2:878.1: Kusalo ca avvyākato ca dhammā kusalassa dhammassa atthip. paccayo. (a) Sahajāto kusalo eko khandho ca vatthuñ ca tiṇṇaṃ khandhānaṃ atthi . . . pe . . . dve khandhā ca vatthuñ ca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ atthi. . . .
patthana1.2:879.1: Kusalo ca avyākato ca dhammā avyākatassa dhammassa atthip. paccayo. (a) Sahajātaṃ, (b) pacchājātaṃ, (c) āhāraṃ, (d) indriyaṃ. (a) Kusalā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthi. . . . (b, c) Kusalā khandhā ca kabaliṅkāro āhāro ca imassa kāyassa atthi. . . . (b, d) Kusalā khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañ ca kaṭattārūpānaṃ atthi . . .
patthana1.2:880.1: Akusalo ca avyākato ca dhammā akusalassa dhammassa atthip. paccayo. Sahajāto akusalo eko khandho ca vatthuñ ca tiṇṇaṃ khandhānaṃ . . . tayo khandhā ca vatthuñ ca ekassa khandhassa . . . dve khandhā ca vatthuñ ca dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ atthi. . . .
patthana1.2:881.1: Akusalo ca avyākato ca dhammā avyākatassa dhammassa atthip. paccayo. (a, b, c, d):-- (a) Akusalā khandhā ca mahābhūtā ca cittasamuṭṭhānānaṃ rūpānaṃ atthi. . . . (b, c) Akusalā khandhā ca kabaḷiṅkāro āhāro ca imassa kāyassa atthi. . . . (b, d) Akusalā khandhā ca rūpajīvitindriyañ ca kaṭattā-rūpānaṃ atthipaccayena paccayo. 22.
patthana1.2:882.1: Kusalo dhammo kusalassa . . . natthip. paccayo. Purimā purimā kusalā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ kusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ natthipaccayena paccayo. . . . Sankhittaṃ . . .
patthana1.2:884.1: Kusalo dhammo kusalassa . . . vigatap. paccayo. Purimā purimā kusalā khandhā pacchimānaṃ pacchimānaṃ kusalānaṃ khandhānaṃ vipākapaccayena paccayo . . . . Sankhittaṃ.
patthana1.2:886.1: Kusalo dhammo kusalassa . . . avigatap. paccayo. Kusalo eko khandho tiṇṇaṃ khandhānaṃ . . . dvinnaṃ khandhānaṃ avigatapaccayena paccayo. . . . Sankhittaṃ.
